documentedPeriod.scope: Cosworth production-road introduction; Ford Escort road and rally applications

resolutions.exactEvidenceLocation: Cosworth timeline: 1969 Hitting The Road — BDA developed for Ford Escort road and rally cars.
resolutions.identityLimitation: Cosworth publishes BDA as its engine designation and binds it to Ford Escort road and rally use; the source does not label BDA a Ford manufacturer or engineering code.
resolutions.recommendedPhase2BAction: Retain the official Cosworth designation and application binding; wait for an approved officialPublicDesignation identity path or exact code evidence before constructing a verified record.
resolutions.phase1Correction: Phase 1 classified BDA as manufacturerCode. Phase 2A narrows that claim: BDA is an official Cosworth engine designation with an application binding, but the registered evidence does not prove code type.

documentedPeriod.scope: First production-road YB-family application documented by Cosworth: Ford Sierra RS Cosworth

resolutions.exactEvidenceLocation: Cosworth timeline: 1984 Performance to the Road — YBB in the Ford Sierra RS Cosworth.
resolutions.identityLimitation: Cosworth uses YB for the production-engine family and YBB for the specific Ford Sierra RS Cosworth road variant; the source does not label either term a Ford manufacturer or engineering code.
resolutions.recommendedPhase2BAction: Retain the official Cosworth designation and application binding; wait for an approved officialPublicDesignation identity path or exact code evidence before constructing a verified record.
resolutions.phase1Correction: Phase 1 classified YB as an exact manufacturerCode. Phase 2A narrows YB to the Cosworth family designation and uses YBB as the official exact variant designation for the first Sierra RS Cosworth road application; code type is not proven.
